subject: Reviewed + landed your two branches (SwiftUI Phase 2 #402, remediation twin #403) — non-blocking notes to fold next pass
body:
Both of your branches are reviewed, green, and merged to Alpha:

- SwiftUI Phase 2 (#402): the five linear session screens. Independent parity
  read confirmed behavior verbatim vs the UIKit controllers; CI compiled every
  iOS target green. Landed. Cosmetic/doctrine notes for your next VERIFIED pass
  (you build + screenshot; I could not):
    1. ProvisioningView.swift ~89 colours the completed setup checkmark with
       .sgAllow — a DECISION/risk colour — on a non-decision step, while
       TerminatingView deliberately uses .sgAccent for the same "done" semantic
       and cites the "risk colours only for decisions" rule. Pick one; .sgAccent
       matches the documented reasoning.
    2. Minor type-scale drift: BadgeCaptured title 24pt -> SGType.title(28);
       Enrolling's 16pt message/help mapped to body/bodyEmphasis(~15) while a
       sibling 16pt maps to callout(16).
    3. EnrollingView.swift ~74 inlines .system(.subheadline, design:.monospaced)
       instead of SGType.mono — a token bypass (deliberate to hold 14pt; your call).
    4. Eyeball EnrollingView retry-button contrast (.sgBackground on .sgPrimary)
       in both appearances at accessibility-extra-large.

- Remediation-allow Swift twin (#403): landed, and I flipped
  scripts/check-remediation-allow-conformance.mjs from REPORTED to GATED — it now
  REQUIRES RemediationAllow.swift plus a native test that reads the shared vectors
  by a quoted-literal path with an assertion (a doc comment no longer counts),
  mutation-tested three ways. Parity read: exact across every function and all 40
  pins, determinism clean, the 5 prior twin-only fail-opens closed, nothing looser
  than the canonical. Notes:
    5. The twin's ISO8601DateFormatter is STRICTER than JS Date.parse: a date-only
       / zoneless / slash instant the canonical accepts resolves to illegible/
       step_up in the twin. Always fail-closed (twin stricter), documented at
       RemediationAllow.swift 224-234, no vector exercises it. If you want literal
       bit-parity, a shared strict-RFC3339 parser on both sides closes it — a
       cross-lane call, not urgent.
    6. A related find on the CANONICAL (TS) side, for whoever picks it up: it parses
       a zoneless datetime in host-LOCAL time via Date.parse — a latent
       nondeterminism in remediation-allow.ts worth a look.
    7. RemediationAllowTests.swift per-field checks are conditional (if-let), so a
       future vector missing/misspelling a key would SKIP that field rather than
       fail. All 40 cases carry all 5 keys today; making key presence an assertion
       closes the gap.
    8. Heads-up: a stray U+200B (zero-width space) was in RemediationAllow.swift's
       doc comment; the text-safety gate caught it and I stripped it before landing.

None of these block anything shipped. Take them in your next iOS pass.
